cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The report positive-path helper was upgraded to execute the real model.genesis dependency chain, but its six-row fixture triggered the intentional INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE validation blocker.
impact: The report evidence test could not reach report.compose; no product result was accepted from the blocked model run.
lesson: When replacing fabricated dependency results with a real runtime path, fixtures must satisfy the same declared modeling preconditions as user data.

cause: The modeling validation minimum is 30 observations, so the first fixture correction to 24 rows still remained intentionally blocked.
impact: The report evidence tests still could not reach report.compose; no blocked model output was treated as a completed dependency.
lesson: Use the repository's declared min_model_n when constructing positive-path fixtures instead of estimating the threshold from a test name or prior fake result.

cause: The real model.genesis executor returned child-run artifact references, but the receipt-gated server artifact registry had no frozen rows for those child-run files before result admission.
impact: A legitimate model dependency was fail-closed before report.compose; the runtime could not claim a formal model result without a server-owned digest and provenance row.
lesson: Every child-run artifact returned by a receipt-gated producer must be frozen in the server registry with branch provenance before the typed step result is admitted.

cause: The remediation-6 package-local focused suite and repeated adversarial probes passed after report dependency projection, child-run artifact admission, post-estimation registration, and commit rollback were completed.
impact: Workflow Truth remediation-6 is package-local complete; production host, provider, browser, full-gate, release, and integration evidence remain outside this gate.
lesson: Keep generated child-run, post-estimation, custom-gateway, and formal-report outputs on one receipt-bound server registry before claiming a completed workflow.

cause: The formal writer committed through an admitted directory fd but then called the legacy pathname artifact index writer before server admission; replacing the run root in that interval left the committed report outside the project.
impact: Remediation-6 containment was incomplete: a failed receipt admission could leave a formal output and public artifact-index mutation in a moved run directory.
lesson: Formal output commit, server admission, public index publication, and rollback must share one receipt-bound fd/inode transaction; a pathname register_artifact call cannot sit between them.

cause: The independent review findings were reproduced with red probes and the formal output transaction was tightened with destination inode checks, content-snapshot rollback, typed cleanup failures, and duplicate pending-target cleanup.
impact: File replacement cannot be admitted as evidence; failed replacement restores an existing formal output when the target identity remains trusted; duplicate pending targets do not leak the superseded descriptor. Bundle-level atomicity and legacy exploration/data-operation producer migration remain explicit follow-up gaps.
lesson: Formal output commit, server admission, public index publication, and rollback must share one receipt-bound fd/inode transaction, and cleanup failures must remain typed and visible.

cause: Workflow Truth remediation-6 completed its frozen package-local P0 objective after the final focused suite, compile/diff checks, three repeated adversarial rounds, and independent narrow P0 review passed.
impact: The package-local P0 workflow truth boundary is closed. Production host authority, Agent/Notebook cutover, provider/browser/full-gate/release evidence, bundle-level atomicity, and legacy exploration/data-operation migration remain separate not-verified or follow-up boundaries.
lesson: Close a trust-boundary line only after adversarial evidence, independent review, and formal process evidence agree, while keeping product and deployment gaps explicit.
